title: A Part Library number over 50 characters is refused while on an open request
custom_preconds:
Setup (manual QA tester and Claude session)

Preconditions

  • You are signed in as an Admin at {Location-A} (for example Staging Heavy Duty - 9919). The Admin role has 'Part Library & Inventory → View / Create & Edit / Delete'.
  • Inventory part {Part-A} (for example ZZAUTOTEST-PL-LIBLEN-01) is active at {Location-A}.
  • Work order {Work-order-1} (for example S2-15440) is open, for a ZZAUTOTEST customer.
  • Its line {Line-1} (for example "ZZAUTOTEST PL lib length line") holds a part request for {Part-A}, not yet received.
  • {Number-A} is a new number exactly 51 characters long (for example ZZAUTOTEST-PL-LIBLEN-01-XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX).
  • {Number-B} is a new number exactly 50 characters long (for example ZZAUTOTEST-PL-LIBLEN-01-XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX).
custom_steps:
1. In the top bar click Parts, then click Part Library in the left menu.
  2. Type {Part-A} in the Search box.
  3. Click the {Part-A} row.
  4. Click the edit icon beside the entry's name in the Part details panel.
  5. Replace the Part Number with {Number-A}.
  6. Click Save.
  7. Wait 5 seconds.
  8. Replace the Part Number with {Number-B}.
  9. Click Save.
  10. In the top bar click Work Orders.
  11. Open {Work-order-1}.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Step 6: The save is refused and the Edit Library Part dialog stays open. A red error toast reads "Part number can't be longer than 50 characters while it's on an open part request."
  • Step 7: The toast has closed on its own after about 3 seconds.
  • Step 9: 50 characters are allowed (only more than 50 is refused): the change is saved and the detail page shows {Number-B}.
  • Step 11: The part request on {Line-1} shows {Number-B}.

Source — where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-10647; story SV-10824 (Story 11, The Part Library Is Browse and Edit Only); story SV-10826 (Story 13, The Part Dialog); PRD "Parts Lifecycle Update", Confluence 829227015, as edited 9 Oct 2026 (Ready for dev), S11-R3a, S13-N7, §8 User Feedback Summary, read 13 Oct 2026; design canvas board 7.2 (An entry opens its detail page), 13 Oct copy. Source-verified 13 October 2026; not yet build-verified (no Part Lifecycle QA build exists).

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

  • S11-R3a: “Changing an entry's number or description on its detail page follows the part dialog's rules: S13-R12 to S13-R19, S13-N1, S13-N7, and S10-R23 to S10-R25.”
  • S13-N7: “If the new number is longer than 50 characters and the part sits on an open part request, the save is refused with "Part number can't be longer than 50 characters while it's on an open part request."”
  • PRD §8 User Feedback Summary (Rename over 50 characters with an open part request): “"Part number can't be longer than 50 characters while it's on an open part request." | Error toast, fades after 3 seconds; the dialog stays open”
  • PRD §8 User Feedback Summary (context note): “every refusal sent by the system, the rows that fade after 3 seconds, also shows a second, smaller line under the message: "Please try to resolve this."”
